card.architecture: Krea 2 Turbo (8-step distilled; Qwen3-VL 4B encoder, Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE) + yijunwang2 AnyPaint LoRA on the ComfyUI-Krea2-AnyPaint nodes. The added border is the generated region; a full-canvas 384px semantic reference drives Krea 2's reference attention and known tokens are pinned every denoise step, so the original content is preserved without any paste-back composite.
card.summary: Extend the canvas on any side(s) with Krea 2 Turbo. The AnyPaint LoRA continues the scene into the new border while keeping the original pixels exact. Distilled Turbo: 8 steps, no CFG, no negatives.
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 Community License for your use
card.pick_when: You want Krea 2's aesthetic to extend an image beyond its edges, on one or more sides at once.

prompt.guidance: Describe the WHOLE intended picture including what continues into the new area — AnyPaint conditions on the full canvas.
prompt.example: a complete coastal watercolor, the flowering path and garden continuing naturally downward, airy washes
prompt.instructions: Natural language describing the complete extended result. 8 steps, euler/simple, cfg 1. No negative prompts.

negative.note: Distilled few-step (cfg 1 / guidance 0); negatives don't work.

speed.note: 12B-class Krea 2 Turbo, 8 steps, plus the reference K/V precompute. Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Set how many pixels to add on each side and describe the whole picture you want. The original pixels are preserved automatically.
ui_help.good_for: extending an image on any side(s) in Krea 2's look

edit_use_cases: outpaint: grow the canvas on any side and continue the scene into it, keeping the original image exact
